Priya (CSM): FYI CobaltIQ dropped to ~10% of PoC traffic after handoff. spotted the cliff this morning. anyone on this account?
Mark (AE): noticed too. Zoe (new ML lead) joined last weekthey mentioned a side demo with NebulaAI.
Omar (Solutions Eng): any deploys or model changes around the drop?
Priya (CSM): quick check I ran: ```SELECT day, sum(requests) FROM api_calls WHERE account='cobaltiq' AND day >= '2025-12-01' GROUP BY day;``` shows near-zero after 2025-12-12.
billing-bot: invoice COB-2025-12 generated 2025-12-13 status: unpaid.
Zoe (CobaltIQ): hey team we paused while security runs a short review and evaluating NebulaAI for cost on long-doc folding. also need a VPC diagram and KMS policy.
Omar (Solutions Eng): likely mitigation: prefix KV caching + prefetch for repeated sections, adaptive chunking for >10k tokens. should cut token usage ~25-35% for their workload.
Priya (CSM): proposed outreach: "Zoe we can fast-track VPC/KMS docs and run a 3-day dedicated trial (no charge) with KV caching + prefetch so you can compare real results vs NebulaAI. available Thu/Fri 30m slots"
Mark (AE): +1. Add success metrics: >=30% token reduction and <=10% cost delta vs NebulaAI. I'll prep pricing comparison.
security-bot: security pack request logged needs VPC diagram, KMS key policy, SOC2 checklist.
Priya (CSM): action items: Priya -> send security pack + schedule call; Omar -> prepare KV config + perf sim; Mark -> competitive cost slide. I'll follow up after call.
Zoe (CobaltIQ): Thu 11am works; please send docs ahead so our security can review.
Priya (CSM): will send today and confirm the slot. billing-bot: payment reminder sent to customer billing contact.
Priya (CSM): tagging this high priority will update thread after the deep-dive. :eyes:
